notes.title: V1.2 Release
notes.content:
[p]Some players have reported issues such as crashes and the game failing to run on newer computers. To address this, we have updated the game engine to [b]Ren'Py 8.4[/b].[/p][p]Please note the following changes in this update:[/p][list][*][p][b]Save files are not compatible[/b] between version 1.2 and version 1.1. To accommodate this, we have created a separate branch on Steam. If you wish to keep your existing save files, you can revert to version 1.1.[/p][list][*][p]How to switch to another branch:  Right-click the game in your Library → “Properties” → “Betas” → “Beta Participation: Select the beta you would like to opt into” → choose “V1.1”.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Minimum system requirements for version 1.2[/b] are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Windows 10 or higher[/p][/*][*][p]macOS 10.15 or higher[/p][/*][*][p]Ubuntu 20.04 or higher[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]The image compression method has been changed[/b] in this update to further reduce the client size while maintaining image quality.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any issues during gameplay, please feel free to contact us.
Enjoy the game![/p]

notes.title: English Translation Available Now
notes.content:
We are thrilled to inform our English-speaking players that the English translation is now available!

It has been a year since the game's launch. During this past year, our English translation efforts faced some challenges. For this release, we have utilized the latest large language AI model for translation, followed by human proofreading. However, there may still be some oversights in the translation. If you find any parts of the story that do not seem coherent, please let us know. We will make prompt corrections upon confirmation. Thank you!

Thank you all for your support over the past year! Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
